newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products steady, fuel oil seller active.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, fuel oil seller active.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady on Tuesday and largely inactive except for one major which still had high sulphur fuel oil to sell, dealers said.
Gas oil wavered within a 50 cent range and premiums held in quiet trading, with many players absent.
Traders said the Rhine remained navigable despite the cold, although some locks on German tributaries were frozen.
High sulphur fuel oil traded twice at $113 fob ARA, the seller the same in both trades. Bunker demand was poor.
